question.problem:
Evaluate the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}2\,\text{d}V
$$

where $R$ is the type II region given by 

$$
R=\{(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,0\le z\le 1,\,0\le x\le 4-y-z\}.
$$
question.worked_solution:
Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}2\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{4-y-z}2\,dx\,dz\,dy.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{4-y-z}2\,dx\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{4-y-z}2\,dx]dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}[2x]_{x=0}^{x=4-y-z}dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}2(4-y-z)\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}8-2y-2z\,dz\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z,$ treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}8-2y-2z\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{1}8-2y-2z\,dz]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{[8z-2yz-{z}^{2}]}_{z=0}^{z=1}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}8-2y-1\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}7-2y\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}7-2y\,dy & ={[7y-{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=1} \\  & =7-1 \\  & =6\end{aligned}
$$
